about: Jobs found by Claude's weekly browser sweep

items.title: In-Store Sales Lead Generator
items.snippet: In-store brand-ambassador style role: greet shoppers and book free home consultations. Base $17/hr plus commission, paid training, flexible hours. Same skills as his Best Buy demo work.

items.title: Inside Sales Representative - Waterworks
items.snippet: Inside sales at a Fortune 500 supplier in Myrtle Beach. 1–3 years of sales support or customer service; his brand-ambassador and marina customer work counts.

items.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) Remote
items.snippet: Remote SDR, $50k base. Asks 1–3 years of SDR or lead generation; brand-ambassador lead gen counts.

items.title: Part-Time Sales Development Rep
items.snippet: Part-time remote SDR, $18–22/hr, no years of experience listed. Good side income while job hunting.

items.title: Business Development Representative
items.snippet: Remote BDR at a well-funded health startup. Asks 1+ year of high-volume customer-facing work; brand-ambassador shifts count.

items.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
items.snippet: Remote SDR at a software company, $55–66k. Asks 1 year as SDR/BDR or similar.

items.title: Business Development Representative (BDR/SDR), Automotive
items.snippet: Remote BDR selling AI software to car dealers, $60–70k. 1–2 years preferred, not required. AI angle fits his AI web work.
